pr_body:
Fixes #111103.
Epic: CRDB-29380

We want to distinguish the concepts for "tenant", "virtual cluster", "SQL/HTTP instance" through the team. For this it is useful when the tools and their source code also reflect these concepts.

This commit achieves that.

Release note: None
pr_comments: This change is [](https://reviewable.io/reviews/cockroachdb/cockroach/111113)

Cheers.

@herkolategan that said, only roachprod is modified here. The current 'multitenant' roachtests could perhaps remain unmodified, but I'm not sure how much more _infrastructure_ in the roachtest code needs to be updated. Do you want to file a followup action item with a list of things that need work?

> Do you want to file a followup action item with a list of things that need work?

Will do, since we're planning to refactor everything in roachtest to start using the new virtual cluster features in roachprod, we'll update the terminology with those changes.

issue_context.title: roachprod/roachtest: review terminology in flag names and source code
issue_context.body:
**Describe the problem**

`roachprod` (and presumably `roachtest`) use the word "tenant" when really they only support just 1 virtual cluster.

**Expected behavior**

Reflect "cluster virtualization" in the CLI where applicable

Epic: CRDB-29380

Jira issue: CRDB-31766

review_comments: For my own understanding: do we want to deprecate `tenant` as an identifier / concept in the code?
